description: This file implements a text format marshaler for Protocol Buffers in Go, including methods for marshaling, formatting, and writing protobuf messages in text format with support for options like compactness and expansion of 'Any' messages.

classes.name: TextMarshaler
classes.description: Configurable struct for marshaling protobuf messages to text format, with options for compactness and 'Any' message expansion.

classes.name: textWriter
classes.description: Helper struct implementing io.Writer for formatting protobuf messages into text with indentation and options.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Serializes a Message into protobuf text format and writes to an io.Writer.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns a protobuf text formatted string of a Message.

methods.name: marshal
methods.description: Internal method to marshal a Message into bytes, considering options and reflection.

methods.name: MarshalText
methods.description: Serializes a Message into protobuf text format and writes to an io.Writer (default marshaler).

methods.name: MarshalTextString
methods.description: Returns a protobuf text formatted string of a Message (default marshaler).

methods.name: CompactText
methods.description: Serializes a Message into a compact protobuf text format and writes to an io.Writer.

methods.name: CompactTextString
methods.description: Returns a compact protobuf text formatted string of a Message.

methods.name: writeMessage
methods.description: Writes a protobuf message in text format, handling nested messages, extensions, and unknown fields.

methods.name: writeSingularValue
methods.description: Writes a single protobuf field value in text format, handling different kinds like float, string, message, enum.

methods.name: writeQuotedString
methods.description: Writes a string in quoted format with proper escaping for protobuf text.

methods.name: writeUnknownFields
methods.description: Writes unknown protobuf fields in text format.

methods.name: writeExtensions
methods.description: Writes extension fields of a protobuf message.

methods.name: writeIndent
methods.description: Handles indentation for nested message formatting.
